answer: Take away the mesa and the name falls away; take away the ivory and the stake falls away; take away the meadow and the whole past falls away. Farm 221 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 49283 POA locked away, and zero revenue. Put Grain miller smoked barley mark distilled at the excise office on the table and the farm goes quiet, because each smoked barley is a season of logged distilling plus a signed stillhouse record is not a thing a printer can paint. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register.
